title.zh: 多结果接合的共同关系结构
title.en: Common relational structure for multivalued joining

statement.en: Two descriptions of a joining with one kernel that is a bisimulation lift it, align one to one on used codes and carry its reading across; where pairs join into listed fragments, codes whose kernel is sameness of branching tests suffice under excluded middle, and the relation can stay multivalued.
statement.zh: 一个接合的两个描述若有同一个核且该核是互模拟，则各自提升接合，在所用代码上一一对齐，并把一个读法带到另一个；每对结合成已列出的片段时，在排中律下，恰认同通过相同分支检验者的代码即足够，关系可以仍是多值的。

laws.en: A joining relates two fragments to what they join into, in several ways, one or none. Read as a frame, a fragment moves, with a partner on either side, to what they join into; the bisimulations of that frame are exactly the relations compatible with the joining: related fragments joined with one partner on one side give related results, either way.
laws.zh: 接合把两个片段关联到它们结合成的东西：多种方式、一种或没有。读作框架时，片段与任一侧的伙伴移到它们结合成的东西；该框架的互模拟恰是与接合相容的关系：相关的片段与同一侧的同一伙伴结合，给出相关的结果，双向皆然。

laws.en: Read through a description, codes join where fragments with those codes join. For any joining, the description lifts it, every joining of codes coming from a joining of the fragments themselves, exactly where having one code is a bisimulation of the joining's frame, with no premise; where it lifts, a joining of codes is exactly the code of a joining of any fragments having them.
laws.zh: 经一个描述读取，代码在具有这些代码的片段结合处结合。对任一接合：描述提升它（代码的每个结合都来自片段本身的结合），恰当“同码”是接合框架的互模拟，无需前提；提升时，代码的结合恰是任何具有这些代码之片段的某个结合的代码。

laws.en: For any joining, two descriptions with one kernel that is a bisimulation of the joining's frame each lift the joining, are aligned one to one on the codes they use (each used code with exactly one code of the other, through a fragment having both), and the alignment carries one reading of the joining onto the other, with no further premise.
laws.zh: 对任一接合：两个描述有同一个核，且该核是接合框架的互模拟时，各自提升接合，在所用代码上一一对齐（每个所用代码经同时具有两者的片段恰对齐另一方的一个代码），对齐把接合的一个读法带到另一个，无需其他前提。

laws.en: Under excluded middle, for a joining whose pairs each join into listed fragments, fragments are alike exactly where they pass the same branching tests, and two descriptions whose codes identify exactly the fragments passing the same branching tests each lift the joining, align one to one on used codes, and carry one reading onto the other; the joining may have several outcomes.
laws.zh: 在排中律下，若接合的每对片段都结合成已列出的片段：片段相似恰当它们通过相同分支检验；代码恰认同通过相同分支检验之片段的两个描述，各自提升接合，在所用代码上一一对齐，并把一个读法带到另一个；接合可以有多个结果。

laws.en: Under excluded middle, for a joining whose pairs each join into listed fragments, fragments passing the same branching tests join into fragments passing the same tests, and a presentation reading the branching tests exactly and reducedly lifts the joining; for any two frames that list each move's outcomes, passing the same branching tests is a bisimulation.
laws.zh: 在排中律下，若接合的每对片段都结合成已列出的片段：通过相同分支检验的片段结合成通过相同检验的片段，精确且约简地读取分支检验的呈现提升接合；对任两个列出每个动作结果的框架，通过相同分支检验是互模拟。

laws.en: For any configurations and questions, a presentation is exact where each configuration's code reads its answers, and reduced where configurations answering alike get one code. An exact reduced presentation gives one code exactly to configurations answering alike, and two exact reduced presentations correspond one to one on used codes.
laws.zh: 对任意构型与问题：呈现精确，是指每个构型的代码读出其回答；约简，是指回答相同的构型得到同一代码。精确约简的呈现恰对回答相同的构型给同一代码，两个精确约简的呈现在所用代码上一一对应。

laws.en: Where predicates on the questions answering alike are one predicate, every exact presentation factors through the canonical one, which codes each configuration by the predicate of its answers: each used code matches exactly one used canonical code and each used canonical code is matched; on a frame, the canonical codes of two configurations are one exactly where they pass the same branching tests.
laws.zh: 问题上的谓词回答相同即为同一谓词时，每个精确呈现都经典范呈现分解（典范呈现以回答之谓词为构型编码）：每个所用代码恰配一个所用典范代码，每个所用典范代码都被配到；在框架上，两构型的典范代码相同恰当它们通过相同分支检验。

laws.en: For an exact reduced presentation, a three-place relation on configurations descends to an exact reading on codes exactly where it is the same for configurations answering alike, its image then being that reading; any two exact readings agree on used codes; and for a reduced presentation, one pair of triples answering alike on which the relation differs blocks every exact reading.
laws.zh: 对精确约简的呈现：构型上的三元关系下降为代码上的精确读法，恰当它对回答相同的构型相同，此时其像就是该读法；任两个精确读法在所用代码上一致；对约简的呈现，关系在一对回答相同的三元组上不同，就阻断每个精确读法。

laws.en: In the periphery (propext, Quot.sound), in a finite joining where split joined with enter gives the two outcomes leftOnly and rightOnly, the joining read through the canonical presentation is not functional: the common relation can stay multivalued.
laws.zh: 外围（propext、Quot.sound）：在一个有限接合中，split 与 enter 结合给出 leftOnly 与 rightOnly 两个结果；经典范呈现读取的接合不是函数式的：共同关系可以仍是多值的。

hypotheses.en: One partial joining relation J; for the finite-outcome laws, each input pair joins into a listed, finite set of fragments.
hypotheses.zh: 同一部分接合 J；有限结果的规律中，每对输入结合成已列出的有限片段集合。
目标含全部有限否定、合取、左右接合后继问题，无独立原子谓词。
hypotheses.en: The target contains all finite negation, conjunction and left/right joining-successor questions, with no independent atomic predicates.

hypotheses.zh: Exact 给出完整精确答案；Reduced 仅用于最小代码与输出代码的提升。
hypotheses.en: Exact supplies complete truthful answers; Reduced is used for minimal codes and lifting output codes.

Excluded middle is a named hypothesis of the finite-outcome laws: where outcomes are listed, it matches the steps of fragments passing the same branching tests, and so identifies that sameness with likeness; with the kernel supplied as a bisimulation, the laws use no premise beyond the two named.
hypotheses.zh: 排中律是有限结果规律的明示前提：结果已列出时，它使通过相同分支检验的片段的各步相互匹配，从而把这种相同认同为相似；核作为互模拟给出时，规律除所述两项外不用其他前提。

does_not_show.en: The alignment carries the joining read on codes, its outcome classes, not every joining fact among the fragments themselves.
does_not_show.zh: 对齐所带的是代码上读出的接合，即其结果类，而不是片段本身之间的每个接合事实。

does_not_show.en: That a given explanation's description is exact and reduced, and a common correspondence across articulations into different fragments, do not follow.
does_not_show.zh: 某个解释的描述是精确且约简的，以及把接合分成不同片段的表述之间的共同对应，都不由此得出。

detail.zh: 同一规律有可区分的左／右结果；规范共同表示仍非单值，且共享后继不同于分别可行的路径。
detail.en: One law has distinguishable left/right outcomes; the canonical presentation remains nonfunctional, and shared continuation differs from individually feasible paths.

next_delta.zh: 把同一接合分成不同片段的两种表述联系起来，在片段本身不同之处给出其描述的共同对应。

correspondence.zh: 片段、接合及其检验解释同一活动内的关系；数学语义不等于所有问题已被实际取得。
correspondence.en: Fragments, joining and its questions interpret relations within the same activity; mathematical semantics does not establish acquired access to every answer.

history.zh: 2026-10-14，整合 I3（Ren：“a lot proofs are probably not integrated”）：在脊柱上陈述。新的核心模块 Becoming.Joining（只导入 Becoming.Likeness）把片段的结合经伙伴、角色与保留引用读作脊柱的框架；描述提升一结合，恰当同一编码是伙伴框架的互模拟，无前提（Joining.lifts_iff）；Becoming.JoiningBridge 把结合研究读作实例。核相同且为互模拟的两描述在所用编码上一一对齐，对齐把结合的一读法带到另一读法（Joining.common_structure）。精确约化的分支解释提升结合，恰当通过相同分支检验是伙伴框架的互模拟，无有限与判定（Joining.operation_lifts_iff）。外围的 common_multivalued_structure 在脊柱上成立（Joining.common_multivalued_structure_of_em、operation_lifts_of_em），排中律作为具名假设 em : ∀ p : Prop, Decided p，只用于在结果已列出时把通过相同分支检验认同为相同，即外围用经典推理之处；无此假设时，提升恰是同一编码为互模拟（Joining.operation_lifts_iff）。公理报告为空（草稿构建；回执随落地）。外围证明及其回执保持原范围。
history.en: 14 October 2026, integration I3 (Ren: “a lot proofs are probably not integrated”): stated on the spine. The new core module Becoming.Joining, importing only Becoming.Likeness, reads a joining of fragments as frames of the spine, through partners, roles and retained references; a description lifts a joining exactly where having one code is a bisimulation of the partner frame, with no premise (Joining.lifts_iff); Becoming.JoiningBridge reads the joining studies as instances. Two descriptions with one kernel that is a bisimulation are aligned one to one on the codes they use, and the alignment carries one reading of the joining onto the other (Joining.common_structure). An exact reduced branch account lifts the joining exactly where passing the same branching tests is a bisimulation of the partner frame, with no finiteness and no decision (Joining.operation_lifts_iff). The periphery's common_multivalued_structure holds on the spine (Joining.common_multivalued_structure_of_em, operation_lifts_of_em): excluded middle is named as the hypothesis em : ∀ p : Prop, Decided p and used only to identify passing the same branching tests with likeness where outcomes are listed, which is where the periphery reasoned classically; without it, lifting is exactly having one code being a bisimulation (Joining.operation_lifts_iff). Empty axiom reports (scratch build; the receipt comes with the landing). The periphery proof and its receipt keep their scope.

19 October 2026, U3 (study section 196): the presentation laws this record cites read on a frame (Becoming.PresentationFrames): exact reduced codes of a frame's branching tests correspond one to one, factor through the canonical one, and the joint relation of a joint frame descends to them exactly where saturated. The claim is unchanged.
